title: Process crash — restart required
hint: The worker process exited unexpectedly. Check the service logs first to confirm it is not a data issue, then restart.
sql: SELECT TOP 10 * FROM error_log WHERE error_type = 'ProcessCrash' ORDER BY created_at DESC

title: Heartbeat timeout — likely false positive
hint: Usually triggered during deployments. Check if a deployment happened within the last 10 minutes. If yes, close the alert.

title: Duplicate key — SQL cleanup needed
hint: A duplicate record was inserted. Run the query below to identify and remove the duplicate, then close the alert.
sql: SELECT id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM your_table GROUP BY business_key HAVING cnt > 1
